notes.title: The Next Game from ONE OF DAGGERS
notes.notes:
[p]At ONE OF DAGGERS we have been hard at work, creating our latest game [b]Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business.

[/b]A [b]completely free[/b] new game which has been described as a cross between [b]Leisure Suit Larry[/b] and [b]Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas[/b]. Play as good ol' boy Buck Trucker, and raise money for them damn orphans. 


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617560/Buck_Trucker_in_Rowdy_Business/"][/dynamiclink]
Check it out, and play it. Do it for the orphans.
